title: IBM details a 0.7nm chip manufacturing process that utilizes a "nanostack" 3D transistor architecture, which it says can maintain chip innovation for 10 years (Don Clark/New York Times)
summary: Don Clark / New York Times: IBM details a 0.7nm chip manufacturing process that utilizes a “nanostack” 3D transistor architecture, which it says can maintain chip innovation for 10 years — Industry leaders had worried that innovations in chip miniaturization were no longer possible.
